name: effects_only
character: sound effects and ambience only: no notes, no key, no melody, so note and melody rules do not apply; level and layer balance do

focus.reason: an effects piece has no line by definition; the focus row is skipped below

pattern.melody_notes.reason: an effects piece has no melodic line for this row to count

pattern.bass_pitches.reason: an effects piece has no bass line for this row to judge

pattern.flat_dynamics.reason: effects set their own level curve

pattern.four_on_floor.reason: an effects piece has no drum kit to place on the floor

masking.vs_melody.reason: there is no melody to unmask, so the ERB margin has nothing to protect

chroma.concordance.reason: no musical key to clash with

kick.grid.reason: an effects piece has no kick for the grid row to align

focus.declared.reason: an effects piece has no line, so there is nothing to declare
